definitions.explanation: The opposite side from the front.
What is hidden or not openly shown.

examples.english: To write on the back of the paper.

examples.japanese: {裏|うら}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{裏|うら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I know what's going on behind the scenes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏返|うらがえ}す→裏返す：07508_uragaesu⟧。
{裏|うら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are dealings behind the scenes.
Something is going on behind the scenes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏|うら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to the back of the building.
To show the back of one's hand.

notes:
{裏|うら} means the back side, reverse, or hidden aspect of something.

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL BACK:
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏|うら}: back of paper
- ⟦コイン→コイン：10852_koin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏|うら}: reverse side of coin
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏|うら}: back of building

SENSE 2 - HIDDEN/BEHIND SCENES:
- {裏|うら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: behind-the-scenes circumstances
- {裏|うら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧: hidden meaning

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧ (front, surface) ↔ {裏|うら} (back, reverse)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {裏|うら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}せば→返す：09648_kaesu⟧: conversely, on the other hand
- {裏|うら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かく→掻く：09647_kaku⟧: to outsmart, outmaneuver
- {裏目|うらめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to backfire
